dedupe_keys.name: arera comparative publication of electricity service continuity and voltage quality indicators for italian distributors

description: ARERA, the Italian regulator for energy, networks and the environment, publishes each year a comparative publication of electricity service continuity and voltage quality for distribution companies. The announcement of 27 November 2025, issued with resolution 511/2025, covers 2024 in the thirteenth comparative publication of interruptions and the fifth of micro-interruptions. The data concern interruption events attributable to the distributor on medium and low voltage networks, by territorial areas of high concentration (over 50,000 inhabitants), medium (5,000 to 50,000) and low (under 5,000), with a synthetic index combining interruption duration and frequency, and voltage quality on medium voltage networks, focused on severe voltage dips. A new search interface for the number and duration of interruptions of the electricity service was launched with that publication. Coverage is Italian distribution companies and their territories. Access is free on the ARERA website; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: only events attributed to the distributor are counted, and the search interface was not read in detail. Simulation uses are reliability benchmarks for distribution networks and comparison of continuity across urban and rural areas. Related records: data-terna-data-portal-italy covers the transmission level.
